title: Plux analytics: organisation overview
description: Event volume, sessions and Plux errors across the organisation's apps (ANL-020).

list.name: organization
list.label: Organisation ID
list.description: The organisation UUID. Row-level security binds every query to it (SRV-022).

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: The apps of the organisation with rollups.

list.name: release
list.label: Release sequence
list.description: The release sequences of the selected apps with rollups.

panels.title: Events
panels.description: All events in the range, of every event name.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.events), 0) AS "Events"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release);

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Sessions started in the range (session_start events).

targets.rawSql:

panels.title: Plux errors
panels.description: Error events in the range (the error event of Appendix G.2).

targets.rawSql:

panels.title: Screen views

  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'

panels.title: Events by app
panels.description: Events per app over time, one series per app ID.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.bucket, $__interval), r.app_id::text AS metric, SUM(r.events) AS value
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Events by app and event name
panels.description: Event counts per app and event name in the range. Capped at 100 rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', '$organization', false);
SELECT r.app_id::text AS "App", r.event_name AS "Event", SUM(r.events) AS "Events"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF('$organization', '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = '$granularity'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 100;
